label: For any GOD_4 with the classical attributes who can reveal recognizably: if Jesus claimed to speak…
paraphrase: For any God with the classical attributes who can reveal recognizably: if Jesus claimed to speak and act with divine authority and rose from the dead, then that God, by the resurrection, confirms the proposition that Jesus holds a mandate from him. Confirmation is a testimonial act by a sign that is God's own deed; it is not yet the truth of what is confirmed. 'By the resurrection' and 'by a sign' are the intended reading of the uninterpreted Confirms; they are not encoded.
